title: Show HN: Geomatic – a command-driven geometry studio enabled with autodiff
summary: Geomatic is a command-driven geometry studio that uses autodiff (automatic differentiation) to enable interactive geometric construction through text commands like `\line a b`. It combines broadcasting semantics similar to NumPy/PyTorch with backpropagation, gradient descent, and vector field visualization capabilities.
problem_solved: Enables geometric construction and numerical optimization visualization through a simple command-driven interface with built-in automatic differentiation.
why_valuable: Bridges the gap between intuitive command-line geometry creation and powerful autodiff-based numerical analysis, allowing users to visualize optimization processes like gradient descent on geometric constructions.
